e.title: insurance-monitoring
e.summary: 定价模型漂移检测（burning-cost，MIT）：暴露加权的 drift 监控
e.body: insurance-monitoring（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）做定价模型漂移检测：暴露加权的模型漂移（drift）监控——定价模型上线后的持续健康检查。对 RIAA：定价模型的生命周期监控——[[langfuse]]（AI 可观测）的精算侧对应、[[insurance-mlops]]（MLOps 流程）的监控环节；理解「模型上线 ≠ 结束」（漂移检测是生产实践）；配合 [[insurance-deploy]]（部署）做「部署 → 监控」闭环；定价模型治理（PRA 期望）的工程工具。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：burning-cost 仓库 + PyPI 确认（漂移检测，MIT），未实测
e.summary_en: Pricing-model drift detection (burning-cost, MIT): exposure-weighted drift monitoring
e.summary_hk: 定價模型漂移檢測（burning-cost，MIT）：暴露加權的 drift 監控
e.body_en: insurance-monitoring (burning-cost, PyPI, MIT) does drift detection for pricing models: exposure-weighted model drift monitoring — ongoing health checks after pricing models go live. For RIAA: the lifecycle monitoring of pricing models — the actuarial-side counterpart of [[langfuse]] (AI observability) and the monitoring stage of [[insurance-mlops]] (MLOps processes); understand that 'model go-live ≠ the end' (drift detection is production practice); with [[insurance-deploy]] (deployment) it closes the deploy → monitor loop; an engineering tool of pricing-model governance (PRA expectations).
e.body_hk: insurance-monitoring（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）做定價模型漂移檢測：暴露加權的模型漂移（drift）監控——定價模型上線後的持續健康檢查。對 RIAA：定價模型的生命周期監控——[[langfuse]]（AI 可觀測）的精算側對應、[[insurance-mlops]]（MLOps 流程）的監控環節；理解「模型上線 ≠ 結束」（漂移檢測是生產實踐）；配合 [[insurance-deploy]]（部署）做「部署 → 監控」閉環；定價模型治理（PRA 期望）的工程工具。
